Cookie Policy

Last updated: 27 October 2026

We use few cookies, and the statistics ones only after you accept them.

What cookies are

Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser to remember information between visits. Similar technologies, such as the browser's local storage, serve the same purpose.

Cookies we use

  • Necessary: your cookie choice is kept in the browser's local storage (cookies-consentimento), so we don't ask you on every page. It identifies no one and is not shared.
  • Statistics (Google Analytics): only with your consent. The _ga and _ga_* cookies tell visitors and sessions apart, so we know how many people visit the site and which pages they view. They last up to 2 years. Provider: Google Ireland Limited (Google privacy policy).
  • Third-party content: the SoundCloud player and YouTube videos (which only load when you click a video) may set their own cookies, under those services' policies.

Managing your preferences

You can change your choice at any time, here or with the "Cookie preferences" link at the bottom of every page. If you decline after accepting, we turn Google Analytics off and delete its cookies. You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings.

More information

To learn how we handle personal data, read the Privacy Policy. Questions: contato@gringoswashboard.com.br.
